session_summary: Completed Frostfang Pass (difficulty 3) encountering only two minor combat instances (Slime and Kobold) across 12 steps, finishing with full HP and 141 coins. Combat pacing felt overly sparse for a ridge route.

observations.evidence: Out of 12 steps on a difficulty 3 route ('Frostfang Pass'), only two enemies were encountered (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with long stretches of uninterrupted walking and jumping.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy density and introduce staggered threat types on higher difficulty routes to sustain combat pressure.

feature_requests.title: Add Elite Enemy Encounters to Difficulty 3+ Routes
feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-risk, high-reward tactical choices for players seeking mastery and greater engagement.
feature_requests.rationale: Current encounters are too sparse and lack mechanical friction, failing to satisfy combat-focused playstyles.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Incorporate elite variants with distinct behavior profiles into higher-tier routes via content pack adjustments.

keep: Clean route completion telemetry and responsive navigation actions.
focus: encounter pacing, enemy friction, risk/reward, challenge and mastery
